title: Treydan Stukes, Dalton Johnson and Genesis Smith shine at NFL Draft combine

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Treydan Stukes, Dalton Johnson and Genesis Smith shine at NFL Draft combine
sources.description: The trio of former Arizona defensive backs Treydan Stukes, Dalton Johnson, and Genesis Smith took part in the 2026 NFL combine on-field workouts Friday afternoon. All players were listed as safeties and ran the drills alongside each other. Before any sessions of the combine started, the NFL Next Gen Stat grades came in for the […]
